mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which correlates with rising equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 0.5% quarterly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals monetary tightening, which compresses equity multiples and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and payrolls (PAYEMS) signal an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with INDPRO < 95.0 and PAYEMS < 130000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 8.0% signal labor market stress, prompting monetary stimulus expectations that drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 215.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with RSAFS > 350000.0 and HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215.0), rising FEDFUNDS signals aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained INDPRO reading above 100.0 indicates strong industrial output, correlating with economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods with INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
